correctness.rationale: The independent exponential first-clock graphical construction identifies the final matching. Exact one-sided empty-block equations yield f(t)=exp(e^{-t}-1); conditioning on edge first clocks gives p0 and the q_j unilateral cavity recurrence. Volterra iteration and change of variables give the explicit triangular integral for every j. Strict monotonicity in the defect rate forces alternating signs, and normalized triangular-kernel concentration at (1,0) yields the exact coefficient e^{-1}(lambda-1)/(j+1)!. The finite path recursion and integral evaluator completed 250 checks. Limits are fixed lambda>0 and j increasing; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The paper-motivated question is how one kinetic defect changes the jammed state at arbitrarily large distances in irreversible one-dimensional adsorption. Strict sign alternation across every neighbor and the sharp factorial screening constant provide a structural spatial answer and a natural nonperturbative stability law for all positive defect strengths; it is not a routine homogeneous density calculation or arbitrary finite tabulation. No theorem about multiple defects or higher dimension is implied.
